> > Fact From Story: Rosenthal clarified that the deal is not complete and changes are possible, but the base of the deal is Glasnow to the Dodgers.
> > > Fact From Story: Glasnow is expected to sign a contract extension with the Dodgers as a result of the trade.
> > > Fact From Story: Los Angeles has reportedly acquired the right-handed starting pitcher, along with outfielder Manuel Margot, for RHP Ryan Pepiot and OF Jonny Deluca.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Players often sign contract extensions when they are traded.

> > Commonsense Knowledge: A trade involves players going to different teams.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Trades involve more than one team.
